description: Calculate, explain, compare, or apply an N-period simple return for any positive-integer lookback. Use for requests such as 20-period return, multi-period simple return, lookback return, rolling return, or period simple returns; require the period count and sampling frequency.

workflow: Identify whether the request asks to explain, compare, apply, or diagnose a misconception.
